```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class DashboardComponent extends Component
{
    public $expenses = [];
    public $newExpense = '';

    protected $rules = [
        'newExpense' => ['required', 'numeric'],
    ];

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.dashboard');
    }

    public function saveExpense()
    {
        if (Auth::user()->can('add_expense')) {
            $this->expenses[] = $this->newExpense;
            $this->newExpense = '';
            $this->dispatch('expense-added', ['message' => 'Expense added successfully!']);
        } else {
            $this->addError('error', 'You do not have permission to add expenses.');
        }
    }

    public function deleteExpense($id)
    {
        if (Auth::user()->can('delete_expense')) {
            unset($this->expenses[$id]);
            $this->dispatch('expense-deleted', ['message' => 'Expense deleted successfully!']);
        } else {
            $this->addError('error', 'You do not have permission to delete expenses.');
        }
    }
}
```
